about: Insurer level figures used by the ranking (rank.py). Policy wordings do not contain these, so they come from the regulator. IRDAI no longer publishes an insurer-wise claim settlement ratio; the per insurer figure it does publish is the incurred claims ratio (ICR): claims incurred as a share of premium earned. ICR is not the share of claims an insurer pays. claim_settlement_ratio stays null until it is taken from an insurer's own public disclosure and checked by a person.
